worldcombat.skill.hurricane.summary: Conjure a travelling windstorm that starts at the user and sweeps along the aim, lifting and hurling enemies in its path and possibly leaving them dizzy. It is wider and fiercer in rain, and drifts sideways under a clear sky.
Being swept up deals %1$s special damage; the wind can travel %2$s blocks from the user.
The vortex is %1$s blocks across and advances %2$s blocks per tick; a swept target is hurled %3$s blocks along the wind and lifted %4$s blocks.
A swept target is confused with %1$s chance for %2$s s: its actions may be scattered and hitting a non-ally makes it hurt itself.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.weather: Weather shapes the wind: in rain it is steadier, wider and faster and more likely to daze; under a clear sky (day and open sky) it drifts sideways, narrows and is harder to land.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.tight.on: Focused form: a smaller vortex, but more power, a faster advance, a higher confusion chance and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.tight.off: Wide form: a wider sweep that hurls targets further, at the cost of a lighter single blow and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.growth.0: From level %1$s the wind's power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.growth.1: From level %1$s the wind's power rises to %2$s and the vortex widens to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.use.0: Cast a sweeping wall of wind from afar to rake a line of enemies
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.use.1: Lift and hurl a clustered group to break their formation
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.use.2: Raise the wind in rain so the vortex is steadier and dazes more easily
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.preference.t: On: a smaller vortex, but more power, a faster advance, a higher confusion chance and a longer cooldown - for picking a key target off a line. Off: the wide form covers more and hurls targets further, at the cost of a lighter single blow and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hurricane.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger casts wind walls from further away.
On: when other enemies line up behind the target the user raises the wind first (one wall rakes a whole row), possibly leaving a better position to find the line. Off: only the current target's line.
